props.text: BTC Cycle Analysis — Educational framework on drawdown stages and buying windows. Current -50% mid-cycle. Historical lows -77%-84%. Thesis: buying zone within 30-50% of eventual low stays open for months. Reinforces "further downside likely" macro lean. No personal trade action.
